Davis Special Events Gym on the bottom floor of the RPAC. Competitors are encouraged to enter through the event entrance on the Northwest side of the RPAC. This competition does not have a limit on guests. However, **all competitiors or spectators must be wearing a colored wristband** while attending the competition in order to gain access to the RPAC facility should you choose to leave and return later. You can pick up your wristband at the registration table. *Note: Ohio State students, faculty, or alumni with RPAC Access may enter using their BuckID instead of a wristband.*
